notes:
Summary: VectorBid is a programmatic exchange focused on ultra-low-latency bidding decisions. Primary pain: inconsistent tail latency and rising token inference costs for feature-aware reranking models. Wants a predictable inference stack + clear cost levers.

Key requirements / quotes: 
- "Need p95 < 30ms end-to-end on the bidding path; p99 should rarely spike." (CTO)
- 10k TPS sustained across peak windows; bursts to 50k TPS for open auctions.
- Cost-sensitive: current infra spend for model inference is a major line-item; interested in quantization and batching to reduce per-inference cost.
- Must support VPC deployment and KMS for key material; data residency for EU bidders is a hard req.

Technical asks: 
- Benchmarking: want Redwood to run perf benchmark with their payloads and compare host/dedicated/private latency and cost. Specific metrics: p50/p95/p99, tokens-per-dollar, memory footprint.
- Batching/caching: interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching windows that respect latency SLOs; prefix/KV cache for repeated feature contexts. Asking about adaptive batching thresholds and per-customer batch isolation.
- Quantization: evaluate int8 and mixed-precision profiles for their models (LLM-based reranker + small embedder). Need guidance on quality/regression monitoring tied to prompts/evals.
- Routing & fallbacks: prefer automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants when capacity constrained; regional routing for bidder locality.

POC scope: two-week load test using dedicated pool, run quantized model vs fp16 baseline, measure cost delta and latency. Include Redwood Optimize recommendations applied mid-POC to show incremental gains.

Stakeholder notes: 
- Procurement: legal has initial redlines; security wants SOC2 evidence (in progress).
- "If you can show 30-40% cost reduction with no >1% model quality regression, we'll move to committed capacity." — Head of ML Infra.

Next steps agreed: POC kickoff week of 2025-02-10, Redwood to provide test harness, sample scripts, and preliminary perf estimate. AE to follow up with signed NDA and SOW.
